question: Veera Natyam is the famous ritual dance form of which of the following states?
solution:
The correct answer is __Andhra Pradesh.__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An Indian classical dance style with its roots in Andhra Pradesh is called** Veera Natyam.**
 
• Veeranatyam, also known as the Dance of the Brave (Veera, which means brave, and Natyam, which means dance), is a traditional dance from the state of Andhra Pradesh that has religious overtones.
 
• In the beginning, Veeranatyam was a rite conducted in Shiva (Shaivite) temples as a tribute to Shiva. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Eight Indian Classical Dances:**

 
 
• Bharatnatyam Dance
 
• Kathakali Dance
 
• Kathak Dance
 
• Manipuri Dance
 
• Odissi Dance
 
• Kuchipudi Dance
 
• Sattriya Dance
 
• Mohiniyattam Dance
